Priya (People Ops): Morning — quick heads up: Dana's Tue 10:00am PT panel needs coverage (she had a conflict). Who can pick up system-design for senior SWE? Also a rubric clarification: how should we weigh 'problem decomposition' vs 'implementation details' for this level?
Jordan: I can take Tue 10am — I'm in PST so slot works. Do we have a debrief buffer after the interview? I usually need ~10 min to jot notes. :thumbsup:
Elena: Thanks Jordan — great. Debrief buffer: please block 15 min after by default for senior interviews. On rubric: for senior ICs we care more about high-level decomposition + tradeoffs than nitty impl. Proposal: PD 40, Design 40, Implementation 10, Communication 10.
Sam (Eng Hiring): Added Jordan to the calendar and updated the panel in the candidate doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/interviews/dana-2026 (please accept invites). Eval sheet to use: https://redwood.intra/evals/senior-swe — it's the latest version with behavior anchors.
Priya (People Ops): Quick ask — candidate verbal consent for recording confirmed. @Ops Bot can you enable recording and mark 'consent_on_file'?
Ops Bot: Recording enabled for calendar event id 7845123 — consent flag set. Reminder will post 30m before.
Jordan: Got it. One more rubric question: for "implementation details" do we expect code-level optimizations (micros) or more algorithmic choices?
Elena: Implementation = correctness + appropriate algorithmic choices. We don't dock for not knowing micro-optimizations unless role explicitly requires it. Score guidance: prioritize sound tradeoffs and clarity.
Priya (People Ops): Putting the final weights in the eval template for the panel so reviewers see them at-a-glance. I'll also add a short debrief checklist.
Priya (People Ops): Debrief checklist (copy into eval comments):
```
- 15m debrief buffer (required)
- Each panelist adds 2 pros / 2 cons
- Pick a single hire/no-hire recommendation
- If split, hiring manager documents rationale and next steps
```
Jordan: Nice — can we also call out tiebreak policy briefly? I had a split before and folks weren't sure what to do.
Priya (People Ops): Tiebreak policy: hiring manager makes final call after consolidating notes. If still unsure, escalate to Eng Hiring lead (Sam). Document rationale in the candidate doc.
Elena: Agreed. Also please run a quick calibration at the next hiring sync about the PD vs design split — small variance creeping in across panels.
Sam (Eng Hiring): Will add a 5min calibration item to Friday's hiring sync agenda.
Jordan: All set on my side — accepted calendar, will use the updated eval sheet. :raised_hands:
Priya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — tagging the panel: @Jordan, @Elena, @Sam. I'll send a reminder 1 day and 30m before. :calendar:
